What you need to know
Tick each one you know.
Mapping notation: x x + 1 is read “x is mapped to x + 1”. So 3 4.
The domain: x means any real number. “x > 0” keeps only positive inputs.
Table of values: for x2, the inputs −1, 0, 1 give the outputs 1, 0, 1.
Line tests: on a graph, a horizontal line shows inputs that share one output; a vertical line shows outputs of one input.

one-one
Each input has one output; no two inputs share it.
many-one
Two or more inputs can share one output.
one-many
One input gives two or more outputs.
